evidence: view_projection.rs::directional_cascade_view_projection lines 31-42 computes eye = slice_bounds.center - direction * distance, rebuilds a looking_at Transform and light_view from that moving center, then calls snapped_cascade_view_projection. cascade.rs::snap_light_space_center_to_texel quantizes only x/y in the provided light-view coordinates; render_shadow_cascade_view_projection_is_stable_under_half_texel_motion supplies Mat4::IDENTITY for both calls. That test does not cover the caller that rebuilds the coordinate frame. No dynamic matrix or GPU regression was run.
impact: The current fixed-view test cannot establish the intended texel stability for the actual directional-light caller; moving the light-space frame may negate the world-space stabilization.
impact_or_question: The current fixed-view test cannot establish the intended texel stability for the actual directional-light caller; moving the light-space frame may negate the world-space stabilization.
